newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer says to lower 1996 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Acer says to lower 1996 profit forecast.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc said it would hold an afternoon board meeting on Wednesday to lower its 1996 profit and sales forecasts due to a slowing semiconductor and personal computer industry.
"Due to a slowing industry, we will hold a board meeting this afternoon to lower both our 1996 profit and sales targets," a company spokeswoman said by telephone.
But she declined to reveal what the cut ratio might be. "We cannot make any forecast until the board passes the revision," she said.
Acer has set a 1996 net profit target of T$6 billion on sales of T$80 billion.
